concept: Rotation changes facing relationships. Expansion makes an external common court. Overlap creates actual double-counted footprint; full subtraction fails connectivity, selective core subtraction preserves an indoor gallery. The southeast forecourt provides the expanded exterior counterpart.
reference_reading: Reference 1: shared outdoor field between independent wings; do not copy site orientation.
Reference 2: crossing directions generate differentiated voids, not arbitrary decorative polygons.
Reference 3: preserve corner identity while allowing cross-connections.
Reference 4: rotating volumes, actual atria and shared indoor connectors work together; translate process, not campus scale.
hearth_status: Original triangular hearth shown only as a source reference in process diagrams; its location/use is not fixed in the selected non-residential design.
